# nobus_volume (Resource)

A Nobus volume.

Volumes are created asynchronously. After creation the provider polls the volume status reported by Nobus until it becomes available, rather than sleeping for a fixed period.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_volume" "data" {
  name        = "production-data"
  description = "Database data volume"
  size        = 100

  metadata = {
    environment = "production"
    role        = "database"
  }
}

# A volume can grow in place. The provider calls the Nobus extend operation and
# waits for the volume to become available again.
resource "nobus_volume" "logs" {
  name = "production-logs"
  size = 50
}

output "volume_id" {
  description = "ID of the data volume."
  value       = nobus_volume.data.id
}

output "volume_status" {
  description = "Status reported by Nobus, for example `available` or `in-use`."
  value       = nobus_volume.data.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `size` (Number) Size of the volume in GiB. Required by the API. Volumes can only grow: a larger value is applied through the Nobus extend operation, and a smaller value forces a new volume.

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone hosting the volume. Defaults to the provider `availability_zone`.
- `description` (String) Description of the volume. Updatable in place.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the volume is encrypted. Changing this replaces the volume.
- `image_ref` (String) Image to create the volume from. Changing this forces a new volume.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata key/value pairs attached to the volume. Updatable in place.
- `name` (String) Name of the volume. Updatable in place.
- `project_id` (String) Nobus project that owns the volume. Defaults to the provider `project_id`.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Snapshot to create the volume from. Changing this forces a new volume.
- `source_volume_id` (String) Volume to clone. Changing this forces a new volume.
- `volume_type` (String) Volume type, for example `ssd` or `hdd`. Changing this forces a new volume.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_ids` (List of String) Attachment IDs reported by Nobus for this volume.
- `bootable` (Boolean) Whether the volume is bootable.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp reported by Nobus for the volume creation.
- `id` (String) The Nobus volume ID.
- `multiattach` (Boolean) Whether the volume may be attached to multiple instances, as reported by Nobus.
- `server_ids` (List of String) IDs of the instances the volume is currently attached to.
- `status` (String) Volume status reported by Nobus, for example `available` or `in-use`.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp reported by Nobus for the last volume modification.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nobus_volume.data VOLUME_ID
```
